note: Kasane level plan. Vocab: Tanos N3 words not covered by WaniKani 1-35, ordered by JPDB frequency (rank <= 20000). Includes common kana-only words (not on the N5/N4 lists, not too basic, not already a grammar point); words normally written in kana use the kana form. Includes common single-kanji nouns (肌, 霧, 袋...) but not prefixes/suffixes like 大 or 全. Levels 1-2 were written before this plan.
